## Umami v3 流量概览界面数据有 8 小时偏移

在 Umami 的流量概览界面，能看到当前数据有明显的断层，即便是实时产生的浏览量也会记录在 当前 -8 小时的位置，就因为我的时区是 UTC+8

![](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/137720155/533721638-6b1f1d3d-eff3-4f5e-841b-ee4d41429fc8.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJnaXRodWIuY29tIiwiYXVkIjoicmF3LmdpdGh1YnVzZXJjb250ZW50LmNvbSIsImtleSI6ImtleTUiLCJleHAiOjE3ODcwMzc1MTEsIm5iZiI6MTc4NzAzNzIxMSwicGF0aCI6Ii8xMzc3MjAxNTUvNTMzNzIxNjM4LTZiMWYxZDNkLWVmZjMtNGY1ZS04NDFiLWVlNGQ0MTQyOWZjOC5wbmc_.I9hEfax18czY1wuUVao8n4gnneZHoRoy78zWSUqQjIQ)
- [Timezone error in v3.0.1 – “Last 24h” & custom range shift data +5h and exclude valid events · 议题 #3810 · umami-software/umami](https://github.com/umami-software/umami/issues/3810#issuecomment-3741543809)

临时解决方式如 issue 所说，修改 `DATABASE_URL` 环境变量，添加 `?options=-c%20timezone%3DUTC` 参数
